tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// bde mchog lhan skyes kyi byin rlabs bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// bde mchog 'khor lo lhan cig skyes pa'i rang byin brlab kyi rim pa la don gnyis te/ dang po byin rlabs kyi sgo dbye ba dang*/ de'i rgyun nyams su blang ba'o// dang po la gsum ste/ sngon du 'gro ba dang*/ sgra don bshad de nges shes bskyed pa dang*/ dngos so// dang po ni/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa'i phyag len bzhin nam/ mi nus na lhan skyes kyi bsgom bzlas tshar nas tshogs gtor byin gyis brlabs nas/ lhag ma yan chad tshar nas/ 'das pa'i gtor ma bzhugs so// gnyis pa ni/ bde mchog 'khor lo lhan cig skyes pa zhes pa'i don mtshon byed dang*/ mtshon bya gnyis kyi sgra don bshad do// gsum pa sgra don dngos ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad zla la bla ma dang bde mchog tha mi dad pa la/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba mngon sum du blta/ de nas maṇḍal sngon du 'gro bas gsol ba gdab ste/ bla ma'i rjes su/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// dpa' bo chen po dgongs su gsol// lus kyi dri ma sbyang ba dang*// de nyid bde mchog bdag la stsol// zhes lan gsum brjod do// de'i don bla mas bshad do// de nas bla ma'i dpral bar dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku'i ngo bo oṃ dkar po de rang gi dpral ba nas sems can gyi lus kyi ngo bo nyid oṃ la thim pas/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag oṃ bde ba chen po'i rgyun du gyur te/ mgrin pa yan chad gang*/ bde lhan gyis gyur te lus snang stong gi ye shes su ngo sprad la bsgom/ dngos su bla mas bum chu spyi bor blugs/ ku sha dpral bar gzhag go /bum dbang ngo*// yang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin gsung*// la sogs pa gsum 'gre/ lan gsum/

de nas āḥ sangs rgyas dang sems can gyi gsung dang ngag tu dran par byas la/ āḥl āḥthim pas/ gsang dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag snying ga yan chad gang*/ gsal stong gi ye shes su ngo sprad la dar cig bsgom/ dngos su bla mas/ g.yon pa'i khyor bar chu blugs/ ku sha mgrin par gzhag gsang dbang ngo*// yang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin thugs/ la sogs lan gsum/ de nas hūm̐ gnyis sangs rgyas dang sems can gyi thugs dang sems su shes par byas la/ hūm̐ la hūm̐ thim pas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag lte ba yan chad gang*/ bde stong gi ngo sprad la dar cig bsgom/ ku sha snying gar gzhag gsum pa'o// sangs rgyas sku gsung thugs rang bzhin// sogs gsum gyis 'bru gsum/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi yi ge dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum du shes par byas la/ gsum gsum la thim pas/ bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag lus thams cad bde bas gang*/ phyag rgya chen por ngo sprad la dar cig bsgom/ spros pa la dga' na dbang chu bzhin zhib par bshad do// gnyis pa de'i rgyun nyams su blang ba ni/ lhan skyes mngon rtogs skad cig gis mdun du bskyed la/ de dang bla ma tha mi dad la dbang sngar bzhin blang*/ de nas rang lhan skyes su gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi 'od 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad bde mchog tu byas la/ de thams cad kyang rnam pa gsal ba/ ngo bo bde ba/ rang bzhin stong pa ste nyams su myong ba gsal ba'i cha yang ma 'gags la/ rang bzhin stong pa'i ngang las ma g.yos par bsgom/ rab kyi'o// yang na snod bcud lhar byas pa yan chad 'dra la/ de nas snod bcud yum la bsdu/ de yab/ zla ba/ de ha/ de mgo bo/ de zla tshes/ de thig le/ de nā da/ de yang rim gyis thim nas rdo rje sems dpa'i 'od gsal bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang la khri le gzhag go

/ril 'dzin rjes gzhig gnyis thun re bsgoms te/ 'bring gi'o// tha mas ril 'dzin rjes gzhig gnyis ka thun res 'jog tu bsgom/ rdzogs so// lhan skyes kyi byin gyis brlab pa'i lag len tho re tsam bsgribs pa 'di/ ras pa shes rab 'od sngags la cher dad kyang blo'i mthu chung bas nyung la tshang ba cig zhu zer nas/ g.yas ru shangs kyi lu gu sdong du sa skya paṇḍi tas sbyar ba'o// bde mchog gi dbang ma thob pa la mi gnang bar gda'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
